note: Stage, elapsed-millisecond and integer metric values only, copied from the iPhone diagnostics export. No prompt, answer, URL, DOM, account or media content.
sourceFacts: prompt_inserted precedes browser_loaded: readiness came from document.readyState after commit, so the first .task(id: navigationGeneration) filled before didFinish.
didFinish increments navigationGeneration, cancelling the first task inside submitPromptWhenReady; cancellation exits without send_timeout.
The replacement task ran its full 45 s deadline (3043 + 45000 + one 700 ms sleep ~= 48753) without a successful fill, because every successful fill logs prompt_inserted.
No bridge_snapshot change was recorded after 2098 ms although composer state and a later blank page were reported; snapshots are logged only on change.

prompt_length is textContent length, which excludes
line breaks inserted by __starManagerFillPrompt; 479 vs 444 is not by itself proof of lost text.
undeterminedByThisTrace: Whether a later main-frame navigation replaced the document (pre-0.5.5 builds did not log navigation start/commit or cancelled failures separately).
Whether __starManagerSendPrompt rejected the click between 2098 and 3043 ms because the normalized composer text differed from the inserted prompt (pre-0.5.5 snapshots did not report prompt_present).

diagnosticsAddedIn055.navigation_committed: logged at didCommit for the latest navigation
diagnosticsAddedIn055.bridge_ready: logged when readyState readiness marks the page ready before didFinish
diagnosticsAddedIn055.browser_load_failed: failure_kind 1 = cancelled, 3 = other; no longer reported as browser_loaded
diagnosticsAddedIn055.prompt_failed: observer present but fill rejected (logged once per failure streak)
diagnosticsAddedIn055.bridge_failed: observer helper missing or evaluation error (logged once per failure streak)
diagnosticsAddedIn055.bridge_snapshot.prompt_present: 1 when normalized composer text equals the last inserted prompt
